3DCS Roll selection Issue
Development ID: 388821
3DCS Roll selection Issue
Development ID: 388821

###### Table of Contents
1. Business Requirement 2
2. Purpose 2
3. Solution 2
4. Revision History 3

## Purpose
Currently, when a stock correction (Edit Stock) is initiated for a roll that is allocated across multiple OCs, the system freezes the entire roll quantity but does not freeze the OC-level reserved quantities. This results in inconsistencies where stock appears available at the OC level but cannot be physically used due to the roll being frozen.
The purpose of this enhancement is to ensure that both the roll and the corresponding OC-level quantities are frozen during stock correction and correctly reconciled once the correction is approved.

## Business Requirement
When a roll is allocated across multiple OCs and a stock correction is submitted for approval, the system currently cannot determine from which OC the quantity should be unreserved. To handle this, the system freezes the full roll quantity but continues to show OC-level quantities as available for transactions such as GDI.
This creates operational issues where picklists fail due to roll unavailability, despite OC quantities appearing available. The business requires a solution where OC-level quantities are also frozen during stock correction, preventing further transactions until approval is completed.

## Solution
• Enhance the Edit Stock (Stock Correction) process to manage both roll-level and OC-level reservations when a correction is initiated and sent for approval.
• At the time of Edit Stock submission (Waiting / Approval Pending status):
• Freeze the entire roll associated with the stock correction, consistent with existing system behavior.
• In addition to roll freeze, identify all OCs to which the roll is currently allocated.
• Freeze the OC-level reserved quantities corresponding to that roll so that these quantities are not considered available for any downstream transactions.
• Ensure frozen OC quantities are excluded from availability calculations for:
• GDI
• Picklist creation
• Split Roll
• Re-QC
• Edit Stock
• PLT and any other stock movement processes
• System visibility and validation behavior:
• Continue existing behavior where the correction number is not visible until approval is completed.
• Ensure that while the roll and OC quantities are frozen:
• Stock does not appear available at OC level for further allocation.
• System does not allow transactions that would fail later due to roll unavailability.
• OC identification logic during approval:
• During approval, the system will determine the OC from which the quantity needs to be unreserved based on:
• OC selected in the Edit Stock transaction
• Post-approval processing:
• Unreserve the corrected quantity only from the identified OC.
• Update GRN and OC reservation balances accordingly.
• Automatically unfreeze:
• Remaining quantities of the roll
• OC-level quantities for all other OCs not impacted by the correction
• Ensure that corrected and remaining quantities are immediately available for valid transactions after approval.

## Acceptance Criteria
• During Edit Stock approval status, the roll must be fully frozen.
• OC-level quantities linked to the frozen roll must also be frozen and not available for further transactions.
• System must prevent creation of GDI, Picklist, or other transactions using frozen OC quantities.
• After approval, the system must unreserve the edited quantity from the selected OC only.
• Remaining OC quantities must become available again after approval.
